name: Phase E content-aware semantic no-op baseline
purpose: Per-APK rebuild-noise fingerprint (accepted differences with content hashes) for one exact toolchain identity. Separate from the C.4 build baseline and the C.5 schema-1 baseline, which it does not change.

noise_rules.signature_replaced: APK signature files (META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, *.SF, *.RSA/DSA/EC) replaced by re-signing; other META-INF entries are not covered.
noise_rules.certificate_replaced: Signing certificate differs because the APK was re-signed.
noise_rules.dex_reencoded: classesN.dex bytes differ after smali disassembly/reassembly. Class- and method-level changes are separate observations and are never noise.
noise_rules.dex_compiler_marker_removed: R8/D8/L8 build-marker string (~~R8{...}) dropped by smali reassembly.
noise_rules.manifest_reencoded: Binary AndroidManifest.xml bytes differ after AAPT2 recompilation. Its semantic content (permissions, components, compared attributes) is observed separately.
noise_rules.resource_table_reencoded: resources.arsc regenerated by AAPT2. Its entries are NOT compared semantically (known limitation).
noise_rules.resource_reencoded: res/ file recompiled by AAPT2 at the same path (binary XML re-encoding); content is not compared semantically (known limitation).
noise_rules.resource_path_canonicalized: Collapsed resource path (res/Xy.xml) restored to its canonical res/<type>/<name> path; paired by ARSC resource identity or content hash.
noise_rules.manifest_resource_path_canonicalized: Manifest attribute that references a resource file changes only by the same res/ path canonicalization, confirmed by a paired file rename.
noise_rules.manifest_reference_inlined: Manifest attribute (full manifest tree) whose @XXXXXXXX resource reference was replaced by its literal value, or vice versa; accepted only when the reference resolves to that same value in every resource configuration. Observed: AntennaPod FileProvider android:authorities (Apktool 3.0.3).
